Funnel.description:
Funnel follows the same subjects from one milestone to the next
(RFC-0001, "Funis e tempo por etapa"): how many get from each stage to
the next, how long it takes, and who is stuck. Conversion is per cohort
of subjects, never the ratio of two counts in a window.

description.description: Description says what the funnel measures.

subject.description: Subject is the Subject kind followed.

stages.description:
Stages in order; the first is the entry. A subject reaches a stage
with the first milestone of that name after it reached the previous.

cohort.description: Cohort groups subjects by when they entered: day, week or month.

dimensions.description: Dimensions are Subject attributes the funnel can be cut by.

onStuck.description:
OnStuck starts a Function for each subject waiting for a stage past
1.5 times its expected time, once per subject and stage (checked
every few minutes by the scheduler). It receives event.payload
{funnel, stage, subject, since, days}; typically it escalates to the
team.

expected.description:
Expected is how long this stage should take (e.g. 30d). Subjects
waiting for it past 1.5 times this are reported as stuck.

name.description:
Name of the resource, unique per kind within its namespace. Lowercase
letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

namespace.description: Namespace the resource belongs to, usually one per customer.

labels.description: Labels are free-form key/value pairs for selecting and grouping.

function.description: Function to start, in the same namespace.

OnStuck.description: OnStuck names what runs for a stuck subject.
